payload.claim: `_SNAPSHOT_SENTENCE` restates, as a new module constant, the sentence that already exists as an inline literal inside `_stack_revise`'s prompt at line 1043 (`"The checkout is a snapshot of the base.\n"`). The comment above it claims the text is 'reused verbatim,' but nothing imports or shares the value between the two sites; they are two independent literals that happen to agree today. If `_stack_revise`'s wording is edited later, the draft writer's prompt will silently diverge even though the comment asserts they stay identical.
